newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Schroder sets Valero target.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Schroder sets Valero target.

text.p: Schroder & Co analyst Michael Mayer has set a target price of $32 per share for Valero Energy Corp, which began trading on a when-issued basis on Friday after completing the spinoff of its refining and marketing and the merger of its natural gas business with PG&E Corp.
"We have adjusted our target price and upside/downside ranges downward by $13.50 to reflect the closing of the transaction," Mayer said in a research report.
The stock was indicated at 28-1/2 - 29-1/2 in New York trade. The stock was due to open today.

Mayer said in the research report that the strength of Gulf Coast refining margins and the success of the Basis refinery acquisition means that the stock can trade into the upper third of his valuation range of $38 per share.
